name: Devil's Gakuran
source:
Devil's Gakuran is a short japanese horror style visual novel set in 1992. It tells a story of a teenage boy who fell in love and felt so hopeless, he sold his soul to the devil to get what he wants.

[From [url=https://koltonkennedy.itch.io/devils-gakuran]Itch.io[/url]]
